h1: No-Minimum Custom Badges for Small Orders
metaDescription: Order small quantities of no-minimum custom badges at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for small teams, events, or samples. Fast turnaround.
introHtml: Not every order needs to be a bulk run. Our no-minimum custom badges are designed for buyers who need small quantities — as few as one or two badges. Whether you are a small business owner stocking up for a team of five, a marketing director ordering samples for a client pitch, or an HR manager recognizing a single employee, you get the same product quality and customization options as large orders. No forced extras, no wasted inventory.
heroAltText: A close-up of several no-minimum custom badges featuring a company logo and name, available in small quantities.
